name: Khalida
canonNotes: Warrior-Queen of Lybaras, famed for intelligence, bravery and justice, who died young and wakes in times of need blessed by the goddess Asaph.
Hates Neferata and the vampires for her death; seeks the Books of Nagash to keep them from unworthy hands.
voiceNotes: Regal, just and fierce; speaks of honour and vengeance on the Lahmians.
Fair to honest allies, merciless to vampires.
sources: Total War: WARHAMMER III, in-game unit lore (summarised, not quoted)
